text: Blossom Key (Hong Kong) Holdings Limited, which owns 50% of Nativus's parent CR Verlinvest Health Investment Limited, is a wholly owned subsidiary of CRH (CRE) Limited, itself a wholly owned subsidiary of China Resources (Holdings) Company Limited.
short: Blossom Key is wholly owned by China Resources (Holdings) Company Limited.

source.name: Oatly Group AB — Annual Report on Form 20-F for fiscal year 2025 (SEC EDGAR), Item 7.A, footnote (1)
source.quote: Blossom Key (Hong Kong) Holdings Limited is a wholly owned subsidiary of CRH (CRE) Limited.
source.note: The same section continues: 'CRH (CRE) Limited is a wholly owned subsidiary of China Resources (Holdings) Company Limited.' (a page-number artefact splits the two sentences in the filing's text layer).

additionalSources.name: Forbes (Carlton Reid) — The Malmö District Turning Industrial Ruins Into Climate Assets—And Why Oatly Moved In
additionalSources.quote: Oatly is part-owned by The Blackstone Group, Verlinvest, via Nativus Company Limited a part of China Resources (a conglomerate owned by the Chinese state)
